notes.title: Update 0.2.4 (Winter's update) and official release
notes.content:
The game is officially released and available freely for anyone !


 Removed top wrenchs UI
 Add winter's obstacles
 Set snow as starting weather

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Added "music speed" parameter:
Music speed now dynamically adjusts based on the car's velocity, enhancing immersion and adding pressure during high-speed driving sequences.
 End-game difficulty revision:
End-game mechanics have been reworked to prioritize player dodging skills over RNG elements, providing a more balanced and skill-driven experience.
 Slight pixelation reduction:
Pixelation effects have been slightly reduced to improve visual clarity while maintaining the retro aesthetic.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Added a settings menu usable from main and pause menu
 Moved sound settings to the new settings menu
 Separate effect and music volumes
